findings.summary: The AC-dm-17 and AC-dm-48 behavior (fix a field then click submit; confirm/cancel/Esc on every status action) has no e2e run yet. These primitives aren't mounted by any page, and tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts and the pages belong to sibling units.

server/http/errorHandler.ts did not exist yet, so httpClient assumes the error body { error: { code, message, details?, requestId? } }. It also accepts { error: "text" } and an x-request-id header. A network failure becomes ApiError status 0, code network_error.

evidence.summary: tsc --noEmit (covers src, server, shared, tests) found 0 errors; vite build succeeded

messages.text: Primitive APIs: TextField({ id, label, value, onValueChange?, hint?, optional?, error?, onErrorChange?, validate?(value)=>string|null, valid? } + input props). The error line is always reserved. With onErrorChange the parent owns the error; without it the field keeps its own copy, re-seeded whenever the error prop changes. validate runs on blur, except when focus moves to a submit button of the same form or to an element under [data-skip-blur-validation]. While an error is shown, validate runs again on each change, so fixing the value clears the error (AC-dm-17). CnpjField({ value: masked string, onValueChange(masked) }) is optional by default, has label 'CNPJ', inputMode numeric, maxLength 18 and validates with getCnpjError on blur. Pass extractCnpjDigits(value) to the API. MoneyField({ cents: number|null, onCentsChange(cents|null), validate?(cents) }) uses inputMode decimal and the caret-preserving mask; null is an empty field.

ConfirmDialog({ open, onOpenChange, title, consequence, confirmLabel, cancelLabel='Cancelar', tone: 'destructive'|'gate'|'metal' (default destructive), onConfirm: () => void|Promise<void>, pending?, dataId? }). Radix traps the focus, Esc cancels and the focus starts on Cancel. The dialog stays open while onConfirm's promise runs and closes only when it resolves. A rejection shows error.message inline (role=alert) and keeps the dialog open. While busy, both buttons are aria-disabled and Esc/Cancel are blocked. The second click of a double-click (event.detail>1) never confirms. Pass the destructive count in consequence (AC-dm-07). StatusView({ state: 'loading'|'empty'|'error', title?, description?, action?, onRetry?, retryLabel='Tentar de novo', icon?, dataId? }) renders data-state, role=status for loading and role=alert for error.

httpClient.get/post/patch/put/delete<T>(path, body?, { query?, signal? }) only accepts paths that start with '/api/' and are same-origin. query skips null, undefined and empty values. It returns undefined on 204 or a non-JSON response and throws ApiError { status, code, message, details?, requestId? }. Use isApiError(e) to branch on e.code, e.g. 409 when deleting a company that is not archived.

httpClient expects backend errors as { error: { code, message, details?, requestId? } } with the HTTP status preserved. Please keep server/http/errorHandler.ts and domainError on this shape, or tell the frontend lane. Remaining integration checks: pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts (AC-dm-17: invalid CNPJ, fix it, click Salvar right after; AC-dm-48: confirm and cancel for archive, restore and delete, Esc cancels, focus trapped, no native dialogs) and tests/e2e/calculator.spec.ts for MoneyField (AC-dm-15).
